title: Capture real wiki-hop journals as fixtures (no network, no model)
what:
Setup:
- Temp HOME and XDG_CONFIG/DATA/STATE/CACHE/RUNTIME; swarm off in the temp config (guard.sh asserts both).
- Copy P1's jev and fake-browser into the temp plugins dir. In the COPY only, rewrite the service ports in tools/choose.rn and entail.rn to 48091, and every token_file to an absolute path under the temp HOME. Trust and grant in the temp config.
- Run stub_service.py on 48091 and real eidolon `workflow run ... --provider mock`.
Cases:
- (a) MODE=first, completed
- (b) MODE=flat, parked, then `workflow resume --answer=0` until done
- (c) MODE=none: 'chooser unavailable' park, plus the resume refusal text
- (d) SIGTERM mid-run: cancelled
- (e) the graph's `failed` final, reported by the door as completed with exit 0 (pre-P1 graph against the long article)
- (f) a rule pick (label equals goal) and a single-option pick
- (g) jev_entail errors while the run continues, so the later park cannot resume
- (h) an invalid park answer that re-parks and uses up an escalation
For each case save:
- the `eidolon log --json` ndjson, which includes the jev_graph page ToolResults
- the last stdout line, exit code and stderr
Also write capture.sh and a README recording the eidolon (bab3813) and plugin commits and the observed shapes (double-JSON input; tool_use_id == call_id).
tests:
- `capture.sh --check` re-runs every case and compares record kinds and order, with ids and timestamps normalized.
- `grep -c ModelSpend` is 0 in every fixture.
- HOME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME and XDG_RUNTIME_DIR are asserted temporary before any eidolon call.
live_check: This run is the check. Show the tool sequence per case (jq over WorkflowStep.tool), the case (c) refusal text, and case (e)'s exit 0 next to its failed jev_mark.
risk: Every eidolon start rewrites <config>/eidolon/system, so it must be the temp config. Never touch ~/.config/eidolon or ~/Minerva.
